mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where both INDPRO and HOUST decline by at least 1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%), a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% annually signals deflationary risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with deflationary risk
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS < 3.0 and CPIAUCSL < 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) reading below 1000 thousand units indicates a severe housing market downturn, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months where HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and weak employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating consumer economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS growth is below 0.1% and RSAFS declines by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of supply shock (INDPRO decline > 2% from prior month), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where INDPRO declines by more than 2%.
